searchKicker.en: Find a route you can edit

searchLead.zh: 按目的地、线路、天数或活动类型搜索。草稿只保存在这台浏览器。
searchLead.en: Search by place, route, days or activity. The draft stays in this browser.

noResultsWhy.zh: 可能是关键词太窄，或天数、活动类型把结果滤掉了。下面不会编造线路。
noResultsWhy.en: The words may be too narrow, or the day and activity filters removed every match. No extra routes are invented.

seeSouth.en: See South Island routes of 7–10 days

primaryBadge.zh: 主模板 · James 审定·待乐天确认
primaryBadge.en: Primary · James reviewed, Letian has not confirmed

altBadge.zh: 备选 · James 审定·待乐天确认
altBadge.en: Alternate · James reviewed, Letian has not confirmed

oneWayNote.zh: 单程，可能涉及异地还车。
oneWayNote.en: One way: you may return the car in another town.

draftNote.zh: 草稿只保存在这台浏览器。
draftNote.en: This draft stays in this browser.

noPlacesInRegion.en: No places in this directory yet

unmappedRegion.zh: Waitaki（不在 TNZ 南岛 11 区，未归入上面的地区）
unmappedRegion.en: Waitaki (not one of the 11 TNZ South Island regions, so it is not filed above)

mapChooseNote.zh: 此地图用于挑选行程地点，不能用于导航。
mapChooseNote.en: This map is for choosing stops, not for navigation.

noKeyNote.zh: 本机没有可用的 Google Maps 密钥，所以这里用示意图和列表。密钥只放在本地配置，不要提交到仓库。
noKeyNote.en: No usable Google Maps key is configured here, so this is the schematic map plus the list. Keep a key in local config only, and do not commit it.

missingCoords.zh: 没有坐标，只出现在列表里。
missingCoords.en: No coordinates, so it stays on the list only.

donePicking.en: Done choosing, back to the itinerary

hiddenChosen.en: Chosen but hidden by the filter

tightTitle.zh: 这些地方至少需要约 {min} 天，你选了 {have} 天。行程和地图仍然留在下面，没有自动删点。
tightTitle.en: These places need about {min} days; you chose {have}. The days and the map stay below. Nothing was removed for you.

addDayEnd.en: Add a day at the end

clearBody.zh: 本机草稿会被清空，这一步不能撤销。
clearBody.en: The draft in this browser will be cleared. This cannot be undone.

keysHint.zh: 键盘：Alt+↑/↓ 移动当天，Alt+Shift+↑/↓ 也可整日移动。
keysHint.en: Keyboard: Alt+↑/↓ moves the day. Alt+Shift+↑/↓ moves the whole day as well.

sourceOfficial.zh: 来源：线路表所标官方行程页
sourceOfficial.en: Source: official itinerary page named in the route table

sourceOsrm.zh: 来源：OSRM（基于 OpenStreetMap，ODbL）。不是官方读数，也不是本站核验值。
sourceOsrm.en: Source: OSRM (from OpenStreetMap, ODbL). Not an official reading and not a figure checked by this site.

sourcePlanning.zh: 来源：线路表中的规划估算
sourcePlanning.en: Source: planning estimate in the route table

ferryNote.zh: 这一天的备注里写了渡轮。渡轮时间不记成驾车路时。
ferryNote.en: The notes for this day mention a ferry. Ferry time is not shown as driving time.

paceAlert.zh: 这一天的路时原文已经写到接近或超过每日 5 小时的节奏。没有改写数字。
paceAlert.en: The driving text for this day already says it is close to or over a 5-hour day. The figures were not rewritten.

toastDeleted.zh: 已删除这一天。地点放在未安排里。
toastDeleted.en: Day deleted. Its places are in Unscheduled.

summaryEmpty.zh: 简介留空：表里这一栏没有正文，这里不代写。
summaryEmpty.en: Summary left blank: that field is empty in the table, and it is not filled in here.

suggestedStay.zh: 建议停留约 {n} 天（编辑估算，不是官方强制）。
suggestedStay.en: Suggested stay about {n} day(s) (an editorial estimate, not an official requirement).

docLive.zh: 步道状态以 DOC 实时公告为准。目录只是线索。
docLive.en: Track status follows the live DOC notice. This directory is only a clue.

sportsBlock.zh: OSM 运动场地（另一页，不是观光攻略）
sportsBlock.en: OSM sports venues (a separate page, not a sightseeing guide)

openSports.zh: 打开这座城市的运动页
openSports.en: Open the sports page for this city

emptySights.zh: 本目录尚未收录已核景点。
emptySights.en: No checked sights are listed for this place yet.

trackSearchPh.zh: 按名称、城镇或地区搜索
trackSearchPh.en: Search by name, town or region

namePending.zh: 没有中文名，显示 DOC 英文名。
namePending.en: No Chinese name; the DOC English name is shown.

configHelp.zh: 把 docs/local-config.example.js 复制为 docs/local-config.js（已在 gitignore），填入 POUNAMU_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY。页面不默认加载这个文件。本站线上不注入密钥。
configHelp.en: Copy docs/local-config.example.js to docs/local-config.js (gitignored) and set POUNAMU_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY. Pages do not load that file unless you add it locally. This site does not inject a key for the public build.

openTracks.zh: 打开 DOC 步道目录
